title: Arc theme
description: A quiet, papery fintech light theme: white page, pale grey hero bands, warm-black ink with warm-grey secondary text, one deep teal for actions and three soft pastel card tints (blue-grey, sage, sand). Public Sans at regular weight throughout. The dark sibling is warm near-black with a slate card and a mint action colour.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's dark bands (announcement, slate panel, testimonial, CTA) are the dark colours forced inside those blocks
--accent and --secondary are two pastel card tints; --highlight is a mid sand that the account cards use at 30% for the third
name: arc-theme
